answer.summary:
A bill is about the provision meanings actually chosen, and every introduction route must preserve them: the player's own selections; an NPC's goals, knowledge, authority and feasible choices; coherent generated initial law; and explicitly isolated test fixtures. Alternatives come from those four routes, not from the docket. Docket context enables a position to be considered, it does not select every position automatically, and a sponsor's beliefs are not the whole bill — so do not load every alternative under an issue into an enacted law. Before wiring anything, trace the precise policyAlternativeIds type and its consumer: a procedural instrument can legitimately carry no substantive alternative when its procedural effect exists. Empty legacy alternative ids do not erase meaningful tax or bundle provisions, but a title and a summary are not a substitute for an actual effect.

Sourced issue vocabulary and authored simulated policy choices have different provenance. Current boundary checks loaded IDs: do not mint unadmitted per-bill definitions directly in a save. Preserve operative tax/budget provision meaning. One selected alternative drives text, evaluation and eventual effect; unselected options never execute.

title: What a bill should be about, and where its alternatives come from
usableAnswer: A rule for where the alternatives come from, and whether it is the same rule for all seven paths or differs between a player filing a bill, a scenario seeding one, and the institution generating one. If a bill may legitimately have no alternatives — a purely procedural measure, say — say so, because then the empty list is correct for some callers and the question becomes which ones.
whyItMatters: The policy catalogue landed on 2026-09-22 with 13 domains and 127 issues, so the game now knows what politics is about. introduceMeasure accepts the list of alternatives a bill is choosing between, and not one of the seven callers passes it, so every bill in every game carries an empty list. A bill is not about anything. This is the connection between the catalogue and the thing a legislator actually does, and until it is made, the catalogue is reachable by nothing.
